description:
Visit https://hensonshaving.com/robwords or use code "robwords" to get 100 free blades with the purchase of a Henson razor. And watch this video to discover where Henson and hundreds of other surnames came from!

Our last names reveal the lives of our ancestors. Though it's not always obvious, they can tell us where they lived, what they did, what others thought of them, and what their first names were.

In this video, let's explore as many English surnames as we possibly can. From Archer to Wright, Anderson to Wilkinson, Short to Strong, and Danvers to Disney, enjoy this journey through the history of family names.
